diagram.title: Data and parameter ownership on the 2x2 mesh
diagram.prediction: Which devices share each input batch slice, and which devices own the two-column parameter slices?
diagram.reading: Device labels are mesh coordinates (data,model). Feature rows are split by data and copied across model coordinates. Weight columns are split by model and copied across data coordinates. Momentum matches the weight ownership, allowing each update to pair a parameter shard with its optimizer-state shard. These shapes and byte counts are checked by the executable exercise.
diagram.alt: A 2x2 logical CPU mesh. Each device owns a (4,4) feature shard of 64 bytes, a (4,2) target shard of 32 bytes, and (4,2) weight, momentum and gradient shards of 32 bytes each.
diagram.scope: Observed logical-CPU shapes and float32 ownership for this lesson fixture; not hardware capacity or communication measurements.
